title: Enable "alert snoozed until"
symptom: The user asks how to enable an alert that shows 'Active alert exists named "NAME". Alert snoozed until hh:mm:ss (x minutes left).'
fix: Snooze it for 5 minutes, or disable all alerts and then enable them.
evidence_quote: Snooze it for 5 minutes. Or disable all alerts and tenable them.
